en: A sports-themed postcard featuring Estonian discus thrower Gerd Kanter in mid-throw inside a stadium, wearing blue shorts and a white shirt labeled 'ESTONIA TDK 525 OSAKA 2007'. The left side includes printed text about him becoming world champion, while the right side shows a postage stamp with his portrait, an airmail label, a circular Tallinn cancellation mark, his large autograph across the center-right, and blank lines for the address.
